translations.translatedText: # Saturday 8.1.2022 (radio)
Corona restrictions are being tightened. In-person teaching continues. The Prime Minister is worried about the corona situation. Women are wanted in the military. Reindeer found. Weather forecast.
## The government tightens restrictions
![In-person teaching in a classroom.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_6199,h_3487,x_0,y_262/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-766093600f3789b2155/1611820306)
Open image viewer
The government thinks in-person teaching may continue in schools. Photo: Benjamin Suomela / Yle
The government is tightening corona restrictions. The reason is Finland's poor corona situation.
For example, restaurants will have to close their doors at 6 pm every day. The order applies to restaurants across the whole of Finland.
Even though corona restrictions are being tightened, schools do not have to switch to remote teaching. In-person teaching may continue.
However, the government recommends that pupils take corona home tests. The idea is that pupils test themselves twice a week to see whether they have a corona infection.
The government also recommends that children's hobbies are restricted. The idea is that children's hobbies are not held indoors. Until now, only adults' hobbies have been banned.
## Guidance for private events
![A cardboard parcel and a corona home test strip.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_4031,h_2268,x_0,y_269/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-89654761c9b1fc5ea93/1640608381)
Open image viewer
A corona home test is good to do before meetings. Photo: Johanna Manu / Yle
The government has also given guidance for people's own private events.
The government recommends that only 5 people from outside the family attend meetings. It is good for everyone to do a corona home test before a meeting.
The government says that people must remember their own responsibility when trying to prevent corona infections.
## Marin worried about the corona situation

![Prime Minister Sanna Marin visited Yle's Ykkösaamu in Pasila on 8 January.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_5000,h_2812,x_0,y_520/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-89974561d94b2a9f9d4/1641630677)
Open image viewer
Prime Minister Sanna Marin was interviewed by Yle on Saturday. Photo: Silja Viitala / Yle
Prime Minister Sanna Marin is worried about Finland's corona situation. Corona is spreading quickly, and there are many corona patients in hospitals.
Prime Minister Marin says that corona restrictions are needed so that hospitals do not become too full. It is important that hospitals can treat all patients.
In the Yle interview, Marin also said that corona vaccinations are the best way to prevent corona.
## Women wanted in the military
![Female recruits in the snow during shooting exercises.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-11246603)
Open image viewer
Military service is voluntary for women. Photo: Mauri Ratilainen / AOP
More women are wanted in the Finnish military. The goal is that about 2,000 women start military service in a year.
For example, last spring about 1,700 women applied for military service.
Military service in Finland is compulsory only for men. Women can join the military if they themselves want to. Military service lasts at least 165 days.
If a young person does not want to join the military, they can do civilian service. Civilian service can be, for example, work in some organisation.
## Police found the reindeer
![A runaway reindeer in Helsinki on 7 January 2022.](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_extract,w_1599,h_900,x_0,y_0/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,ar_16:9,dpr_1/f_auto/39-89963261d846b364b1b/1641563893)
Open image viewer
A reindeer moved around in Helsinki over the weekend. Photo: Lehtikuva
The police have caught the reindeer that moved around in Helsinki. The police caught the reindeer on Saturday.
Now the reindeer is at the Korkeasaari zoo. From there it is reported that the animal may also be a deer.
## The weather is cold
![weather map](https://img.img-cdn.yle.fi/crop_fill,w_767,h_431,dpr_1/f_auto/13-3-12263086)
Open image viewer
The weekend is cold in a large part of Finland.
On Sunday in the north there is frost of as much as 20 to 30 degrees. In the south there is frost of less than 10 degrees.
On Monday the frost also tightens in the south, and across the whole country there is frost of about 15 to 25 degrees.
